name: market-crypto-brief
description: Daily market and cryptocurrency brief using web APIs and RSS feeds

steps.name: fetch-crypto-data
steps.prompt:
Use the fetch tool to get cryptocurrency data from CoinGecko API:

URL: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,cardano,solana,polkadot&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true

Extract and format:
- Coin name
- Current USD price (formatted with $ and commas)
- 24h change percentage with ↑↓ arrows

Return as a clean list.

steps.name: fetch-market-indices
steps.prompt:
Use web search to find current values for major stock market indices:
- S&P 500
- Nasdaq
- Dow Jones
- FTSE 100
- DAX
- Nikkei 225

Search for "S&P 500 current value today", "Nasdaq today", etc.

Extract:
- Index name
- Current value
- Daily change (+/- points and percentage)

Return as structured data.

steps.name: fetch-market-news
steps.prompt:
Fetch these financial news RSS feeds for market-moving headlines:

1. Bloomberg Markets: https://feeds.bloomberg.com/markets/news.rss
2. Reuters Business: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/businessNews
3. CNBC: https://www.cnbc.com/id/19746125/device/rss/rss.html
4. MarketWatch: https://feeds.content.dowjones.io/public/rss/mw_topstories

Extract 5-7 top market-related headlines from last 24h with brief context.
Return as list: Headline — 1-line summary.

steps.name: format-brief
steps.prompt:
Create a Discord-formatted Market & Crypto Brief using the data below.

**Cryptocurrency Prices:**
{{crypto_data}}

**Market Indices:**
{{market_indices}}

**Market News:**
{{market_news}}

FORMAT (Discord markdown):
```
📈 **Market & Crypto Brief — {current date}**

**💰 Top Cryptos**
• BTC: $XX,XXX (↑X.XX%)
• ETH: $X,XXX (↓X.XX%)
• ADA: $X.XX (↑X.XX%)
• SOL: $XXX (↑X.XX%)
• DOT: $X.XX (↑X.XX%)

**📊 Market Indices**
• S&P 500: X,XXX (↑XX pts / +X.X%)
• Nasdaq: XX,XXX (↓XX pts / -X.X%)
• Dow: XX,XXX (↑XX pts / +X.X%)
• FTSE 100: X,XXX (↑XX pts)
• DAX: XX,XXX (↑XX pts)
• Nikkei: XX,XXX (↓XX pts)

**📰 Market Headlines**
• [Headline] — brief context
• [Headline] — brief context
• [Headline] — brief context

_OpenFang Market Brief — Data via CoinGecko & News Feeds_
```

Keep under 2000 characters. Use proper Discord formatting with emojis.
